housing.text: Deen supports streamlining permitting and reducing red tape to make building in local communities easier and less expensive.
housing.quote: Let’s tackle rising costs by ensuring accountability in the utility and insurance industries while streamlining permitting and reducing unnecessary red tape to make it easier and more affordable to start a business or build in our communities, while maintaining strong environmental and safety protections.

schools.text: Deen says her school-board work has focused on strengthening neighborhood public schools and retaining teachers.
schools.quote: As school board president, I’ve worked to strengthen neighborhood public schools, ensure safe learning environments, retain great teachers, and expand affordable pathways to college and future-ready careers.

health.text: Deen stated she is agnostic regarding single-payer healthcare versus existing insurance models and favors compromise measures.
health.quote: Sometimes you have to move on a compromise measure to do something good for the community. So today, where I sit, I’m agnostic to what we do moving forward.

safety.text: Seo supports increasing funding for police, deputy sheriffs, Highway Patrol officers, and prosecutors.
safety.quote: That's why in the State Assembly, Paul will partner with law enforcement and work to increase funding for more police, deputy sheriffs, prosecutors, peace officers and Highway Patrol officers.

abortion.text: Seo supports protecting access to legal abortion and says he supported California's constitutional abortion-rights measure.
abortion.quote: Paul also believes that California must protect access to safe, legal abortion for all.

health.text: Seo supports universal health care and expanding Medicaid coverage for Californians who need it.
health.quote: With Donald Trump gutting Medicaid funding for our most vulnerable, Paul will work in the State Assembly to help expand coverage for those who need it.
